trigger.requiredOutcome: Bind one real non-interactive Codex model runtime and one fixed validation runtime without granting arbitrary shell, caller-selected execution or canonical-tree authority.

sdd.reason: The real model executable, saved-authentication use, provider-network mode, output schema, candidate materialization and physical acceptance boundary change the D0043 credential/network/runtime contract.

acceptedDecision.modelProcess: release/deployment-bound codex exec with ephemeral JSONL, read-only sandbox, ignored user configuration except saved authentication, release-owned output schema and deployment-bound model configuration
acceptedDecision.credentialBoundary: Codex may reuse the user's existing saved CLI authentication; tdev does not read, copy, serialize, log or forward credential bytes.
acceptedDecision.disclosureBoundary: The complete bounded regular UTF-8 tracked content of one exact published tdev commit and admitted instruction may reach the user's Codex service; mutable worktree/index, untracked/external paths, inherited environment and Git/provider/Agent/MCP credentials are excluded.
acceptedDecision.providerPolicyBoundary: Provider retention, training, privacy, residency, billing and hostile-provider authenticity remain user-account/provider terms and are not tdev claims.
acceptedDecision.retryBoundary: One outer Codex launch per Attempt; timeout, disconnect, response loss or unknown provider billing/effect never authorizes blind replay.
acceptedDecision.resultBoundary: Codex returns one schema-valid relative-path ChangeSet; tdev materializes only a disposable candidate and Promotion remains the sole canonical writer.
acceptedDecision.validationBinding: installed npm plus literal run check, finite bounds, explicit secret-free environment and disposable candidate root
acceptedDecision.releaseRule: v2 manifest, adapter, schema and validator alter the installable-Agent package identity and require fresh source/package/physical qualification plus quiescent activation
